2) Confirm the procurement timeline (are the target dates above feasible?).
3) If any other internal approvers need to be added, please flag them.

I've attached a first-pass MAP (FinServe_MAP_v1.xlsx) that mirrors our call. Once you confirm stakeholders I will update the RACI and send v1.1.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 15m sync if that helps.
